parts.text: I plan and run flights for my company, and I am the licensed person responsible for each flight. I decide which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I can call off a flight. I use help to find out which of my drones could get to where a job starts, but our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us.
